notes:
Founder-led discovery. Founder: Ari Goldman (cto/founder). Small product team building in-app support + document search. Wants hosted API — self-serve is ideal. Key asks: 'We need simple pricing so I can forecast — show me per-message and per-embedding cost compared to OpenAI/Anthropic.'

Call highlights (3/4):
- Wants to keep things public-cloud for now (GCP preferred). No on-prem in initial phase.
- Runs a multitenant help widget; expects ~50-200 qps peaks for special campaigns, typical steady-state ~5-15 qps. Latency target: sub-250ms token generation for chat flows.
- Cost sensitivity: early-stage, founder wants <$10k/mo initially, scale plan to $30k/mo later if product-market fit.
- Model preference: 'open to open models if quality/cost competitive' — comparing Redwood-hosted curated models + Redwood rates vs OpenAI/Anthropic.
- Security: needs SSO for admin console, audit logs for API keys, data deletion on request. No HIPAA now.

Quotes / founder tone: 'We can self-serve but we need clear pricing so I can commit budget to this month.' 'If latency + cost are in line, we can flip on Dedicated later.'

Sticking points: tokenization differences (they have lots of short messages + long docs for embeddings), embedding cost math unclear. Legal wants a one-page summary of data handling + retention. Founder asked for a side-by-side cost example: 100k chat tokens + 200k embedding tokens per month.

Actionables: Priya to prepare cost estimate with 3 scenarios (conservative/predictable/burst), include sample billing calc for 100k/200k tokens, include latency SLO notes. Jordan to add founder to pricing trial and grant $500 credits for immediate testing. Attach drive doc once ready.

Internal notes: Good fit for hosted API self-serve path. High chance to convert if pricing is competitive vs OpenAI/Anthropic and founder can see quick billing predictability. Keep messaging simple — founders appreciate per-conversation examples rather than per-token jargon.
notes_brief: Founder Ari G. inbound SMB. Wants clear hosted API pricing vs OpenAI/Anthropic, self-serve, public cloud. Next: send pricing comparison + credits, follow-up week of 3/15.
